title: Onboard nova-lite-6b-v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Maya Chen
description:
Onboard nova-lite-6b v1.0 into the model registry with metadata, production performance profiles, and automated changelog/release notes generation. Motivation: nova-lite-6b is a small, low-cost variant that we expect to use as a fallback model for latency-sensitive routes and for customers on constrained budgets. This PR adds standardized metadata entries (model name, architecture, tokenizer, supported precisions), performance profiles measured across our standard seqLen/bs distributions, and wiring for generating changelog entries when performance profiles or metadata change.

What this PR does (summary):
- Add model metadata YAML and registry entry for nova-lite-6b v1.0
- Add perf profiles for t0-32/t0-128 sequences with throughput and p95 latency numbers (CPU/GPU quantum where applicable)
- Add automated changelog hook that extracts diffs from model metadata/perf profiles and generates a draft release note in the registry UI on merge
- Add docs snippet and quickstart example referencing nova-lite for cost-sensitive workloads

Implementation notes: single PR composed of focused commits (see commits list). Performance numbers were generated with benchmark-lab using the standard perf harness and validated on both a p4d-preview cluster and a local 4090 rig for smaller batches. The changelog automation is implemented as a small GH Action (+ registry webhook) that runs on merges to main; the action collects changed files under models/nova-lite-6b and creates a draft changelog entry via the registry internal API.

Checklist:
- [x] Metadata schema validated against registry schema
- [x] Perf profiles added and validated (unit tests + cross-check against benchmark lab)
- [x] Changelog hook unit-tested in CI (mocked API)
- [x] Docs snippet added and linked to quickstarts
- [x] Reviewed and approved by infra and docs

Notes and follow-ups:
- We intentionally use the "lite" quantization profile by default; ops teams should consider a canary on small traffic before routing 100% of fallback traffic to nova-lite.
- Next PR will add canary traffic policy and cost-estimates per-route (ENG-4210).

Lina Gomez (reviewer): The changelog GH Action needs a retry/backoff when the registry API returns 429 — added a suggestion.
Maya Chen (author): Implemented exponential backoff and a single retry; unit test added to mock 429 responses.
Ethan Brooks (approver): Docs look good. Approved after adding a brief migration note for customers using route pinning.
